units.source_text: 野宫外面围着一道柴垣，里面各处建造着许多板屋，都很简陋。

en.t: Outside the shrine at Nonomiya ran a brushwood fence, and within it many plank huts had been built here and there, all very plain and rough.

units.source_text: 然而门前那个用原木造的牌坊，形式非常庄严，令人肃然起敬。

en.t: Yet the torii before the gate, made of unhewn logs, had a very solemn form and inspired reverent awe.

units.source_text: 那些神官三三五五，在各处交谈，夹着咳嗽之声。

en.t: The shrine priests stood in small scattered groups, talking in various places, their voices mingled with the sound of coughing.

units.source_text: 这光景和外间截然不同。

en.t: The scene was utterly different from the world outside.

units.source_text: 神厨里发出幽微的火光。

en.t: From the shrine kitchen came a faint, dim firelight.
There were few figures about, and the whole atmosphere was desolate.

units.source_text: 源氏大将推想这多愁善感之人，在这荒漠的地方度送岑寂的岁月，何等凄凉孤苦！

en.t: General Genji imagined how bleak and lonely it must be for such a sensitive person to pass silent years in this desolate place.
He could not hold back his sympathy.
